title: Singleton Fourier component
statement: For every coordinate $i\in\{0,1\}$ and every pair $x=(x_0,x_1)\in\{a,b,c\}^2$, the component of the indicator of the event that both coordinates equal $c$, at the singleton coordinate set $\{i\}$ in the three-point product Fourier basis, is $2/9$ when $x_i=c$ and $-1/9$ otherwise.
